The bound for node n: (sum of top avail_n benefits among remaining items through n) + (sum of benefits of remaining items not through n). This equals suffix minus (the benefits of items through n that we "give up"). If avail_n ≥ cnt_n (non-binding), the bound = suffix (no info). So the bound is only informative for binding nodes.
